question:
The record of the enrollment of boys and girls in a school over 6 years has been presented in the following bar graph.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/efabd2ab60ad64b082ab4cc6e73bdd1d5b4c992c1f4cb520bb97362f1e6d9b37.png] 

In which year was the total enrollment the highest?
solution:
**Given:**

There are the records of the enrollment of boys and girls in a school over 6 years have been presented in the following bar graph.

**Calculation:**

The total enrollment of boys and girls in 1995 = 263 + 159 = 422

The total enrollment of boys and girls in 1996 = 245 + 180 = 425

The total enrollment of boys and girls in 1997 = 290 + 250 = 540

The total enrollment of boys and girls in 1998 = 292 + 186 = 478

The total enrollment of boys and girls in 1999 = 329 + 189 = 518

The total enrollment of boys and girls in 2000 = 312 + 205 = 517

Here, the enrollment of boys and girls in 1997 is greater than all years.

**Hence, the highest enrollment was in 1997**
